application.css:
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Playfair+Display:wght@600;700&display=swap');
:root{--ink:#243238;--muted:#718084;--teal:#287f78;--teal-dark:#1e625e;--mint:#e8f4f0;--line:#dce7e4;--cream:#f8fbf9;--coral:#e5876d}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif}.page-shell{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:42px 28px 30px}.hero{background:#dceee9;border-radius:24px;padding:42px 54px 45px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;overflow:hidden}.eyebrow,.step-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--teal)}h1,h2,h3,p{margin-top:0}.hero h1{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(36px,5vw,60px);line-height:1.05;max-width:590px;margin:12px 0 15px}.hero p{color:#56716e;font-size:16px;max-width:520px;line-height:1.6;margin:0}.hero-mark{font-size:150px;color:rgba(40,127,120,.18);line-height:1;transform:rotate(12deg);margin-right:35px}.content-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px;margin-top:24px}.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:30px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(35,70,66,.045)}.section-heading{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:26px}.section-heading h2{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:27px;margin:8px 0 0}.calendar-icon{color:var(--teal);font-size:25px}.count-badge{background:var(--mint);color:var(--teal);border-radius:20px;padding:6px 11px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700}.field-group{margin-bottom:18px}label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 8px}input,select{width:100%;height:46px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;padding:0 13px;color:var(--ink);font:inherit;background:#fff;outline:none}input:focus,select:focus{border-color:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(40,127,120,.12)}input::placeholder{color:#a5b2b0}.two-columns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}.primary-button{width:100%;border:0;border-radius:9px;height:49px;background:var(--teal);color:#fff;font:600 14px 'DM Sans',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;margin-top:5px;transition:.2s}.primary-button:hover{background:var(--teal-dark);transform:translateY(-1px)}.primary-button span{font-size:20px;margin-left:8px;vertical-align:-1px}.booking-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}.empty-state{text-align:center;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:40px 20px;color:var(--muted)}.empty-icon{font-size:32px;color:#9bbab4;margin-bottom:12px}.empty-state h3{font-size:16px;margin-bottom:6px}.empty-state p{font-size:13px;margin:0}.booking{border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:4px solid var(--teal);border-radius:10px;padding:16px;background:#fcfefd}.booking-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}.booking-name{font-weight:700;font-size:16px;margin:0 0 6px}.booking-type{font-size:12px;color:var(--teal);font-weight:600}.booking-info{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:12px 0 14px;line-height:1.5}.cancel-button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#bb6656;font:600 12px 'DM Sans';padding:0;cursor:pointer}.cancel-button:hover{text-decoration:underline}.booking[data-status='cancelled']{opacity:.65;border-left-color:#adbab8}.booking[data-status='cancelled'] .booking-name{text-decoration:line-through}.cancelled-label{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;color:#899693;font-weight:700}.confirmation{background:#e7f5ed;border:1px solid #b9dfcc;color:#276b50;border-radius:9px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:13px;margin:-8px 0 18px}footer{text-align:center;color:#93a09e;font-size:12px;margin-top:24px}@media(max-width:760px){.page-shell{padding:20px 15px}.hero{padding:30px 25px}.hero-mark{display:none}.content-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.card{padding:23px}}

tests.requirement: Include fields for customer name, email address, appointment date and appointment time.
Prevent a booking from being created when required information is missing.
Reject an email address that is not in a valid email format using browser-side validation.
Prevent a booking from being created for a date in the past.
After a valid booking is submitted, display the booking in a visible list or booking area.
Display a visible confirmation after a valid booking is successfully created.
Allow each booking to be cancelled. Cancellation may either remove the booking from the active list or clearly mark it as cancelled.
Keep booking data in page memory only. Refreshing or reopening the page must reset the booking data.
